name: Peel
description:
Lift the subject out of any photo, Live Photo, GIF or video, give it a die-cut outline, and use it from the emoji keyboard in every app. In Messages you can peel it off and stick it onto a bubble.

- **One-tap background removal** with the same engine as Photos' "Copy Subject".
- **Animated stickers** from Live Photos, GIFs and videos (30 fps HEICS, within Messages' 500 KB limit).
- **Lives in the emoji keyboard.** Tap a sticker to insert it, or "+" to make a new one without leaving the app.
- **Add Sticker from any photo.** Touch and hold the subject of a photo in Photos, Safari or Messages and tap Add Sticker. Live Photos come out animated (iOS 16).
- **Peel and stick.** In Messages, touch and hold a sticker to peel it off and drop it on any bubble.
- **Fix the cut-out** with crop, an Erase & Restore brush, Lasso and Smart Lasso.

After installing, switch any keyboard to emoji and tap the sticker icon at the bottom left.

Background removal needs an A12 chip or newer.
